answer.reason: The wilderness of Sin is where Israel murmured against Moses and Aaron for hunger, while the other marked verses are a camp list and a different Sin in Egypt.

clauses.english: was where the Israelites murmured against Moses and Aaron for hunger
clauses.quote: to kill this whole assembly with hunger

doubts: EZK 30:15-16 speaks of Sin, a city of Egypt, not the wilderness of Sin, so I left those verses out.
NUM 33:11-12 only lists the camp stages through the wilderness of Sin, so I did not use it for a clause.
The murmuring in EXO 16:2-3 is in verses not marked as naming the record; I took it from the context because it follows directly on their arrival in Sin.
